headline: Vedanta submits SEBI Takeover Regulation 31 disclosure for Hindustan Zinc
sum: Vedanta Limited filed a Regulation 31 disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations with the stock exchange, signalling a material acquisition or delisting proposal affecting Hindustan Zinc Limited shareholders.
implication: Regulation 31 disclosure triggers mandatory open offer and fair-value determination requirements; the filing confirms Vedanta is crossing or intends to cross a substantial-acquisition threshold in HZL, obligating public shareholder protections under SAST framework.
detail: Vedanta Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE regarding Hindustan Zinc Limited. This disclosure is a gating step in any substantial acquisition or delisting process, requiring the acquirer to declare its shareholding intent and trigger mandatory open-offer or creeping-acquisition exemptions. The filing date of 23 June 2026 marks formal regulatory notification to the exchange.
